title: pilosella verruculata
intro: Pilosella verruculata, commonly known as Rough Hawk's-beard, is a species of flowering plant in the dandelion tribe within the sunflower family. It is valued for its medicinal properties, particularly in traditional folk medicine, where it is used to treat various health issues. The health benefits of Pilosella verruculata include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, which may help alleviate symptoms of conditions such as arthritis and skin irritations. The therapeutic actions of the plant are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and sesquiterpenes, which exhibit anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties.
